name: headless-step-refine
description: Step 2 (refine) of the Hostinger Headless flow. Turns the user's seed — often just a domain — into a brief through conversation: asks what they want to build (purpose, audience, tone, pages, products, must-haves; images, local files, links all welcome), then *infers* the backend that fits (WordPress, Ecommerce, WordPress + Ecommerce, WordPress + WooCommerce for a one-site content+store, or PocketBase for a custom app/SPA or any site whose visitors create its data: accounts, bookings, comments, votes, order requests) — it never asks the user to pick a backend or a technology; it asks for the site name (suggesting a few when the user has none), the user confirms the plan (and the image source) in plain language, and only after their yes it writes brief.md. Hostinger Ecommerce stays the default for selling; WooCommerce is chosen only when the user explicitly asks for it or wants content and a store on one WordPress site.
